title: WoW Forever Bug Report Forum Guidelines
author: Kaivax

short_news.title_en: WoW Forever Bug Report Forum Guidelines

path: WoW Forever Bug Report Forum Guidelines
changes.text: Topics or replies that are not focused on reporting bugs or providing steps or other evidence to reproduce the issue will be removed.

path: WoW Forever Bug Report Forum Guidelines
changes.text: Not getting a Blizzard/Blue reply does not mean that your issue is or is not a bug, and it does not mean that your post has been ignored. We read every single post in this forum. We cannot reply to all (or even most) threads.
It’s also always a good idea to include the full name of your character and the ruleset you were playing on when you encountered the issue.
